findings.title: Materials' 53-point lens gap
findings.body: Materials trades at 15.82x forward but 32.14x trailing, a 53-point percentile gap — the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 103 percent earnings growth, an extraordinary bet that the current earnings trough is about to reverse violently.

findings.title: Health Care's 44 percent compression
findings.body: Health Care's forward multiple sits at 19.22x, 44 percent below its trailing 34.58x, with the forward percentile 12 points richer than trailing. That compression implies 80 percent earnings growth, a level of optimism that seems detached from the sector's modest one-week and one-month percentile moves.

findings.title: Utilities' trailing percentile is 1
findings.body: Utilities' forward P/E of 17.34 sits at the 24th percentile, but its trailing multiple of 17.99 is at the 1st percentile — a 23-point gap. The forward lens sees a sector near mid-range, while the trailing lens says reported earnings have never been this cheap in five years, a disconnect that hinges on only 4 percent expected growth.
